options.name: archive
options.description: When set to V(true) the system attempts to create a compressed tarball of the running container. The O(archive) option supports LVM backed containers and creates a snapshot of the running container when creating the archive.

options.name: archive_compression
options.description: Type of compression to use when creating an archive of a running container.

options.name: archive_path
options.description: Path the save the archived container. If the path does not exist the archive method attempts to create it.

options.name: backing_store
options.description: Backend storage type for the container.

options.name: clone_name
options.description: Name of the new cloned server. This is only used when state is clone.

options.name: clone_snapshot
options.description: Create a snapshot a container when cloning. This is not supported by all container storage backends. Enabling this may fail if the backing store does not support snapshots.

options.name: config
options.description: Path to the LXC configuration file.

options.name: container_command
options.description: Run a command within a container. The O(container_command) can be used with any state except V(absent). If used with state V(stopped) the container is V(started), the command executed, and then the container V(stopped) again. Likewise if O(state=stopped) and the container does not exist it is first created, V(started), the command executed, and then V(stopped). options.name: container_config
options.description: A list of C(key=value) options to use when configuring a container.

options.name: container_log
options.description: Enable a container log for host actions to the container.

options.name: container_log_level
options.description: Set the log level for a container where O(container_log) was set.

options.name: directory
options.description: Place rootfs directory under DIR.

options.name: fs_size
options.description: File system Size.

options.name: fs_type
options.description: Create fstype TYPE.

options.name: lv_name
options.description: Name of the logical volume, defaults to the container name. If not specified, it defaults to E(CONTAINER_NAME).

options.name: lxc_path
options.description: Place container under E(PATH).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of a container.

options.name: state
options.description: Define the state of a container. If you clone a container using O(clone_name) the newly cloned container created in a stopped state. The running container is stopped while the clone operation is happening and upon completion of the clone the original container state is restored.

options.name: template
options.description: Name of the template to use within an LXC create.

options.name: template_options
options.description: Template options when building the container.

options.name: thinpool
options.description: Use LVM thin pool called TP.

options.name: vg_name
options.description: If backend store is lvm, specify the name of the volume group.

options.name: zfs_root
options.description: Create zfs under given zfsroot.
